body_lead: Bengaluru : With artificial intelligence increasingly seeping into governance across the country, the stateâs power sector could also use it to its full potential. By 2047, Karnataka aims to run its grid operations fully based on AI-based predictions . In every asset, distribution and transformer, it will be visible within minutes for things that used to take weeks, said Gaurav Gupta , additional chief secretary, energy department, Saturday.
